output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The increase in balanceOf[target] is not checked for overflow, allowing the totalSupply to be manipulated.
The _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The check balanceOf[_to] + _value is prone to overflow, allowing attackers to make balances negative.
The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The decrease in balanceOf[msg.sender] is not checked for underflow, allowing the totalSupply to be manipulated.
The Typo Constructor vulnerability is triggered due to a typo in the function name, causing unexpected function calls.
